explanation: This code shows OSR triggering logic and thresholds. The FeedbackVector has an osr_urgency field (0-6) that controls when OSR is attempted. The tiering manager increments osr_urgency as functions become hotter. There are also invocation count thresholds for OSR: invocation_count_for_osr (500) for Turbofan OSR and invocation_count_for_maglev_osr (100) for Maglev OSR.
